theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_eventually_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → 0 < θ → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ n) ≤ μ (Metric.ball x ρ)
